title: Swap {{fromAsset}} to {{toAsset}}
description: Decentralized native swaps at the best available rate.
addOrConnectAccount: Add or connect an account to swap
feeWarningMessage: Total fees exceed {{percent}}% of this transaction. Proceed with caution.
totalFeesTooltip: The total estimated cost of the swap, including network and liquidity fees. Calculated as a percentage of the expected amount received before fees.
slippageToleranceTooltip: The maximum difference between the estimated rate and the final swap rate you are willing to accept.
durationTooltip:
Estimated total time until your assets arrive. This includes:

- Network confirmation: Time needed for your deposit transaction to be confirmed on the blockchain.
- Swap execution: Time needed to complete the asset swap across liquidity sources.
- Transfer processing: Time needed to send the swapped assets to your destination wallet.
